title: Affine etale neighbourhood of the image of a quasi-compact scheme
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $E$ be an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], and let $C$ be a quasi-compact $S$-scheme [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] with an $S$-morphism $c:C\to E$. There exist an affine $S$-scheme $U$ and a representable etale morphism $u:h_U\to E$ such that the scheme projection $V=C\times_EU\to C$ is surjective, etale [def-weil-etale-morphism], separated [def-weil-proper-morphism], and locally quasi-finite [pqf-def-quasifinite]. Here affine means isomorphic to $\operatorname{Spec}A$ for a commutative ring $A$, and the fibre product is the sheaf fibre product represented by a scheme, as in [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Neither $E$ nor $S$ is assumed separated or quasi-compact, and $V\to C$ is not asserted quasi-compact.

source.place: Tag 0APL, proposition-sheaf-fpqc, proof paragraph choosing the affine etale U above the quasi-compact image; Tags 03FX (lemma-cover-by-union-affines), 03BX (lemma-topology-points), and 03FZ (lemma-separated-cover). Local quasi-finiteness of the etale scheme projection is Morphisms Tag 03WS, lemma-etale-locally-quasi-finite, in morphisms.tex.

proof.text: Take a scheme atlas w:h_W -> E directly from [def-trf-algebraic-space], and represent its base change along c by P with projection p:P -> C. Surjectivity follows from IsSurjective w. Étaleness of the same chosen projection follows from IsEtale w: the private helper property_of_represented_pullback uses Mathlib MorphismProperty.relative.of_exists and relative.property to transfer an isomorphism-invariant property to every representing square. Yoneda fullness [lem-pc-yoneda] identifies the other projection with b:P -> W. Choose the ordinary affine open cover A of W [lem-weil-pbc-affine-opens-basis]. The sets O_i=p(b^{-1}(range(A_i -> W))) are open by [lem-weil-pbc-etale-morphism-open-map], and cover C because p is surjective and A covers W. Compactness [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] and Mathlib IsCompact.elim_finite_subcover give a finite set J of indices, allowing J empty when C is empty.

source.place: Tag 0APL, affine chart selection and represented pullback paragraph; scheme-test implementation of the finite-cover argument.

proof.text: Form U as the finite scheme coproduct of the selected affine charts [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-coproduct-family]. Give it the map to S obtained by Sigma.desc of their maps through W. It is affine by the Mathlib finite-coproduct IsAffine instance, which realizes [lem-weil-pbc-finite-affine-coproduct-spectrum]. The induced k:U -> W is étale by IsZariskiLocalAtSource.sigmaDesc since each component is an open immersion [lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation]. The private helper yoneda_isEtale represents every test by the ordinary pullback in Over S and uses étale base change, proving IsEtale (yoneda.map k). Compose with w using isEtale_comp from [def-trf-algebraic-space] to obtain the desired u.

source.place: Tag 0APL, affine chart selection and represented pullback paragraph; scheme-test implementation of the finite-cover argument.

proof.text: Since U is affine it is absolutely separated. Apply the second clause of [lem-a1-separated-etale-chart] to choose a represented pullback V -> C with separated projection v. Transfer étaleness from IsEtale u to this same v with property_of_represented_pullback. This retains the required IsPullback witness and proves both Etale v.left and IsSeparated v.left.

source.place: Tag 0APL, affine chart selection and represented pullback paragraph; scheme-test implementation of the finite-cover argument.

proof.text: For surjectivity, form the ordinary scheme pullback Q=U x_W P in Over S [def-pc-fibre-product]. Yoneda preservation of pullbacks and pasting with the square defining P identify Q with the pullback of u along c. Uniqueness of pullbacks and Yoneda fullness [lem-pc-yoneda] give an isomorphism e:Q -> V preserving projection to C. For x in C, the finite subcover supplies i in J and z in P with p(z)=x and b(z)=A_i(y). The coprojection of y gives y' in U with k(y')=b(z). The scheme point-lifting fact Scheme.exists_preimage_of_isPullback, used in the Mathlib leaf [lem-weil-pbc-base-change-image], supplies t in Q above y' and z. Then e(t) maps to x, proving surjectivity without a topology or point-class equality on E.

source.place: Tag 0APL, affine chart selection and represented pullback paragraph; scheme-test implementation of the finite-cover argument.

proof.text: Finally Etale v.left gives local finite type and an open-immersion diagonal by Mathlib instances. Apply the already proved scheme theorem Scheme.Hom.isLocallyQuasiFinite_of_unramified [lem-weil-pbc-unramified-quasi-finite-at-points], giving local quasi-finiteness in the sense of [pqf-def-quasifinite]. Package this with the preceding witnesses.

source.place: Tags 03WS and 02V5, étale implies unramified implies locally quasi-finite.

split_report.summary: Split the affine-chart paragraph of Gabber's Tag 0APL proof. The first step uses the existing affine etale cover of an algebraic space, openness of etale maps, quasi-compactness, and finite affine coproducts to choose one affine chart whose image contains c(C). The second step uses the pointwise fibre-product criterion and etale base change to prove that V is a surjective etale scheme over C. The separatedness input is isolated in a statement-only chart lemma, and the existing algebraic-space etale-to-locally-quasi-finite lemma supplies local quasi-finiteness. The statement and all hypotheses are unchanged.
split_report.blueprint: Realizes the Gabber fpqc-descent input cited in the ancestry of lem-a1-affine-hc0: the affine etale chart selection and the four properties of its pullback in Tag 0APL.

lean.statement: theorem exists_affine_etale_neighbourhood {S : Scheme.{u}} (E : AlgebraicSpace S) (C : Over S) [CompactSpace C.left] (c : yoneda.obj C ⟶ E.obj.obj) : ∃ (U : Over S) (u : yoneda.obj U ⟶ E.obj.obj), IsAffine U.left ∧ IsEtale u ∧ ∃ (V : Over S) (p : V ⟶ C) (q : yoneda.obj V ⟶ yoneda.obj U), IsPullback q (yoneda.map p) u c ∧ Surjective p.left ∧ Etale p.left ∧ IsSeparated p.left ∧ Scheme.Hom.IsLocallyQuasiFinite p.left
